change: Added chest->Sternal Head as primary: pectoralis major (sternal head) is confirmed by multiple sources as a prime mover in the front lever raise alongside lats (shoulder extension/horizontal adduction from hanging position). Added Lats->Rotator Cuff as secondary: standard for any overhead pulling/gymnastics movement to include rotator cuff stabilization. Posterior Deltoid retained as secondary — in the front lever, the shoulder moves from a flexed (overhead) position toward extension as the body rises to horizontal, so the posterior deltoid contributes to shoulder extension alongside the lats.

The 'raise to hold' variant shares the same muscle engagement pattern as the raise; the hold additionally stresses isometric core, which is already represented.
